publisher: International Association of Oil & Gas Producers (IOGP)
purpose: Authoritative safety taxonomy for high-hazard oil & gas activities and critical barrier verification

rules.name: Bypassing safety controls
rules.guidance: Obtain authorisation before overriding or disabling safety controls
verification_questions: I understand and use safety-critical equipment and procedures which apply to my task
I obtain authorisation before: disabling or overriding safety equipment, deviating from procedures, or crossing a barrier

rules.name: Confined space
rules.guidance: Obtain authorisation before entering a confined space
verification_questions: I confirm energy sources are isolated
I confirm the atmosphere has been tested and is monitored
I check and use my breathing apparatus when required
I confirm there is an attendant who can summon rescue
I confirm an emergency rescue plan is in place

rules.name: Driving
verification_questions: I always wear a seatbelt
I do not exceed the speed limit, and reduce speed for road conditions
I do not use phones or operate devices while driving
I am fit, rested and fully alert while driving
I follow journey management requirements

rules.name: Energy isolation
rules.guidance: Verify isolation and zero energy before work begins
verification_questions: I have identified all energy sources
I confirm that hazardous energy sources have been isolated, locked and tagged
I have checked there is zero energy and tested for residual or stored energy

rules.name: Hot work
verification_questions: I identify and control potential flammables and ignition sources
Before starting any hot work, I confirm work area is free of flammable materials and atmosphere has been tested
I stop work if flammable vapors or gases are detected

rules.name: Line of fire
rules.guidance: Keep yourself and others out of the line of fire
verification_questions: I position myself to avoid: moving objects, vehicles, pressure releases, dropped objects
I establish and obey barriers and exclusion zones
I take action to secure loose objects and report potential dropped objects

rules.name: Safe mechanical lifting
rules.guidance: Plan lifting operations and control the area
verification_questions: I confirm that the equipment and load have been inspected and are fit for purpose
I only operate equipment that I am trained and competent to use
I establish and obey exclusion zones
I never walk under a suspended load

rules.name: Work authorization
rules.guidance: Work with a valid permit when required
verification_questions: I have confirmed whether a permit is required
I am authorised to perform the work
I understand the permit, the hazards, and the controls
I confirm that hazards are controlled and it is safe to start
I stop work if conditions change

rules.name: Working at height
rules.guidance: Protect yourself against a fall when working at height
verification_questions: I inspect my fall protection equipment before use
I secure tools and work materials to prevent dropped objects
I tie off 100% to approved anchor points while outside a protected area
